'''Lazarus Armand''' was the second in command of the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]]<ref name="DS" /> in the [[Vilonis sector/Legends|Vilonis sector]].<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> He hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to covertly transport a [[modular command circuit]] to the [[Kalindan]] government in exchange for information on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloak]]-piercing technology. The modular command circuit would allow the Kalindans to activate their [[Kalindan Defense System|defense network]].<ref name="DS" />
